defect.summary: carry --pregate read the pregate file and bound it to the --head being carried without checking that the checkout was at that head, so a pregate run on one commit could certify a different one.

severity.basis: The fix adds a regression test ('a --pregate from a checkout at another commit never rebinds the receipt to --head') that the old code fails, and the defect lets a gate certify an untested head.
